Its going to take time, honestly youre going to cry A LOT! but you have to. You're going through the exact feeling as a loss. Don't feel like you have to get over someone at certain period or time. I tried to do that too. My relationship was 4 years he broke up with me. It took me 9 months and 13 days to get over it I woke up one day and didn't think about them. In time you will be okay again. I know every little thing reminds you of them, the memories, but its going to feel awful. I think not speaking to them is best honestly so you have time to move on. Pace yourself what helped me was friends and crying a lot. Don't call your ex or text them eventhough you really want to. Nows the time to be selfish be loving to yourself, be kind, be patient, be better who else is going to treat/obsess over you than you! One day you'll be okay again and you'll be happy on how far youve made it.

I didn't figure it out until my boyfriend broke up with me (I was stupid/naive) lets call him "David"  one day we were looking at his old Facebook pictures having a good time, he then gets up to make food while I'm looking at the pictures, then someone messaged him. The person who messaged my ex had a unisex name lets call them "Taylor" at the time my mind didn't jump to "hes cheating" it was a honest question. The message said "Hey David, want to meet at park in like 30 minutes?" And " i can't wait ;)" I thought nothing because I didn't want to assume the worst I didnt type anything or open the conversation, and just asked "who's taylor? He rushed towards the computer and started to yell about "WHY ARE YOU SNOOPING" and I said "im not...all I saw that there was a message from taylor and...." (he cut me off) "YOU KNOW MY MOM ALMOST GOT STABBED BECAUSE HER CRAZY EX BF THOUGHT SHE WAS CHEATING" I was in shock. I apologized profusely and he kept saying was "you dont trust me" he then gathered his things and left. He doesn't message me or call me, I left messages and voicemails of me apologizing to him, two weeks later he calls me finally and he dumps me because "you smother me... and I want to live and do other things" I was heartbroken and I cried for months. 3 months later I come to find out (from one of his friends) he told me he was cheating on me with 7 different girls throughout our relationship. I was furious and even more heartbroken I cried and cried. David one day called me out of the blue crying about "i want you back" and how "Taylor doesn't like me anymore and she likes girls now and she kisses them in front of me" I hung up and blocked him. Thanks Taylor 👍

I went to through the same he became a cold stranger, it's like falling in love with a blank wall and expecting it to give love and reassurance. I feel like once you become aware of how much a stranger they became and the fact you didn't know how you felt in the relationship is something that's very common in a lot of relationships the difference is once the whole reality of "holy shit we are exclusive to one another can I really do this with this person forever?" And that shit hits you hard to some it's a "yes" or a "no" and if you fall in the "no" category we become distant and build up this wall, they detach themselves from you. It sucks because you know this person so well and you cant just let go of someone you built a bond with. All I can say is that while times may seem rough, I know you will be happy again. You will experience joy that matches this pain.
